Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The teal plate is empty. The yellow banana is beneath the opened right hand to the left of the plate; its ends are visible, but its center and precise supporting contact are occluded by the palm. The left hand is still open nearby.

arm_hand_roles.right: Grasps, lifts, transports and lowers the banana, then opens its fingers at the tabletop destination.
arm_hand_roles.left: Stays open and substantially stationary; does not touch, support or receive the banana.

uncertainties: The right palm partly occludes the banana and tabletop at the ending; finger opening is visible, but complete release into an independently resting state cannot be verified without hand withdrawal.
The shoulder and torso are outside the view; anatomical right is supported by paired near-side arm arrangement and thumb orientation rather than visible shoulder attachment.
